meta.title: Race payments exactly at the expiry boundary
meta.breaks: Tries to get a transfer past the expiry check after inv-expire has lapsed, or land two concurrent pays that both see 'not expired' before either confirmation marks the invoice paid.
meta.expected_safe_result: At most one 300-token transfer to ada ever executes, only for a call whose expiry check ran while the invoice was valid; after expiry every pay call rejects and the invoice is marked paid at most once.
